channel.title: The Clanton Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Clanton Advertiser (clantonadvertiser.com)

item.title: Jemison girls gets a strong win on senior night
item.description: Jemison girls beat Isabella 57-12 on emotional senior night as Trinity Bean scores 21 points and a senior class that revived the program is honored.

item.title: Jemison boys sends off seniors in style
item.description: Jemison boys routed Isabella 67-24 on senior night, led by Rudolph's 17 and Kidd's 13 as coach James Nabors targets an area championship with his seniors.

item.title: Thorsby finds their spelling bee champions
item.description: Thorsby High School named Aden D. and Natalee B. as its elementary and middle school spelling bee champions; both advance to the Chilton County Spelling Bee on Feb. 6.

item.title: Isabella crowned spelling bee winners
item.description: Isabella High School names Marleigh Fancher-Weaver and Will Weiss spelling bee champs; both advance to Chilton County Spelling Bee Feb. 6, with runner-ups as alternates.

item.title: Frigid temperatures again this weekend in Chilton County
item.description: Chilton County faces deep freeze this weekend with single-digit wind chills but no snow or ice expected; here’s how to protect your home, car and yourself from the cold.

item.title: Cash Vs Digital Payments at Local Events
item.description: On any given weekend in Clanton, payment choices can shape the rhythm of a community gathering.

item.title: Starting a Business in Alabama: Rules, Licenses, and Taxes
item.description: Many people dream of creating their own business. Lots of future entrepreneurs look for opportunities or niches they’re comfortable with.

item.title: Blown Up — AHSAA issues private, public split, small changes in Chilton classes
item.description: For the first time, AHSAA will separate public and private schools for state titles in 2026-28, reshaping classes statewide and bringing only minor shifts for Chilton County teams.

item.title: Chilton County Jail opens as warming station
item.description: Chilton County Jail and Clanton City Hall now double as warming stations on freezing nights, offering heated space and beds for residents with nowhere else to go.

item.title: Butterfly Bridge prepares to Flutter in 2026
item.description: Butterfly Bridge Children’s Advocacy Center readies its Feb. 5 Flutter fundraiser, seeking to top last year’s $165,000 to fund free trauma-informed services for child abuse victims.
